offer.text: The dead are pressing the gate and I can't hold them alone. Stand with me — cut down five of the undead before they overrun us.

accept.text: Then draw your blade, soldier. Stay near me.

decline.text: Then stand aside and let those who'll fight do it.

in_progress.text: Keep them off me! How many have you felled?

ready.text: Five down and the line holds. We did it.

complete.text: You stood your ground when it counted. The watch remembers that.

failed.text: They broke through while you were elsewhere. We'll be mending walls for a week.
